Conclusion states the scientific result and unresolved domains; AppendixA provides the full principal propositions and definitions rather than relying on unexplained table labels. All30 pages were visually read; final changed pages were re-inspected.

All26 principal claims retain their separate scientific verdicts; the two scalar illustrations do not replace composite claims. Original-source identity and principal findings were checked directly against the dissertation.
